description: EXPLORATORY. CORRECTS THE FRAMING of my own merged probe cyclic_square_does_not_reopen_milnor_probe.py (#6634). That probe measured that the cyclic-square insertion never drives all three pairwise linking numbers to zero -- confirmed here, 0 of 3008 spanning cases across all 16 inserted-sign patterns -- and inferred from it that route 3's conclusion survives, on the grounds that Delta != 0 makes mubar 'not a genuine integer'. That conflates 'not an integer' with 'no obstruction': mubar lives in Z/Delta and a NONZERO RESIDUE is still a nonvanishing invariant. It never computed mubar. Computing it: 563 of 3008 spanning triples carry nonzero mubar (Delta=2: 5, Delta=3: 187, Delta=4: 371) -- and 2 of those are in that probe's OWN all-positive arm, at Delta = 2 with mubar = 1, which is precisely the one bit route 3's stated Delta = 2 residual is about. The probe's title therefore over-claims against its own scope note, which says plainly that the Delta = 2 triples are untouched. STRUCTURAL HALF: the join is sign-independent -- span3 is 188 for every one of the 16 patterns, identically, because the insertion's permutation is a 3-cycle whatever the signs; signs move only the linking VALUES. This does NOT refute route 3 or its Lean, both of which concern the UNPERTURBED carrier at Delta = 0 (control A re-measures that null: 294 triples, 0 nonzero). Scope (a): one insertion shape, one base branch, sampled positions, 4 isotopes. Nothing wired.

what_is_being_corrected.its_measurement_CONFIRMED: the insertion spans 3 components in 188 of 694 all-positive insertions and never drives all three pairwise linking numbers to zero -- reproduced here through a second, independently written analyse()
what_is_being_corrected.its_inference_REFUTED: 'Delta != 0, so mubar is not a genuine integer there anyway' does not give 'no obstruction'. mubar lives in Z/Delta; a nonzero residue is a nonvanishing invariant, and Delta = 2 with mubar = 1 IS route 3's one bit
what_is_being_corrected.its_own_scope_note_was_right: that probe's witness already says 'the Delta = 2 one-bit triples are untouched'. The scope note is accurate; the title and headline are not

the_all_positive_arm.why_it_matters: this is the arm the merged probe itself tested, so these are a correction rather than a new regime

the_join_is_sign_independent.reason: the insertion's permutation s_m s_{m+1} s_m s_{m+1} is a 3-cycle on {m, m+1, m+2} for every sign choice, so WHICH components are joined cannot depend on the signs -- only the linking VALUES can move
the_join_is_sign_independent.consequence: Delta = 0 is unreachable in every pattern (the merged probe's measured claim, extended 16-fold) while mubar is nonzero in 563 cases (its inferred claim, which fails)

control_B_borromean.note: the merged module records the single eps_01(lambda_2) = -1; the full symmetrised mubar here is -2. What this control establishes is NONZERO, not a canonical normalisation

why_the_naive_longitude_readoff_is_legit.objection: Milnor's mubar_ijk = eps_ij(lambda_k) needs the 0-framed longitude; reading one off a braid word gives a longitude differing by a power of the meridian m_k
why_the_naive_longitude_readoff_is_legit.answer: that ambiguity contributes only h_k terms to the Magnus expansion, so the coefficient of h_i h_j with i, j, k distinct is framing-independent

what_this_does_NOT_do.route_3: NOT refuted. Route 3 and MilnorTriplesAreDefinedExactlyWhereTheyVanish.lean are about the UNPERTURBED carrier at Delta = 0; control A re-measures that null
what_this_does_NOT_do.the_lean: unchanged -- no hypothesis of it is touched
what_this_does_NOT_do.other_non_monotone_words: NOT tested. One shape only -- the one #6561 singles out as the sole non-monotone shape yielding a Markov-trace cross term
what_this_does_NOT_do.base_branch: all-sigma^-1 only. The base sign is not varied; the residual being closed here is the INSERTED signs

q0AnchorReason: reads no q0. Inputs are braid words, their closures' permutation cycles, integer linking numbers and degree-2 Magnus coefficients. No substrate pin is evaluated on any path.
